column1: # Font *data* bundled with Cadpole. Fonts are not linked code, so they are
# reviewed here rather than in crates.tsv, under the `fonts-only:` terms of
# reserved_font_names must be "none": Cadpole reserves the right to subset a
# bundled face, and under the OFL a subset of a font that declares Reserved
# Font Names has to be renamed. Recording it keeps that decision explicit.
# `license_path` must ship next to the font, which the OFL requires.
